name: SCAMPER Ideation
deliverable: Systematic transformation of existing concepts using seven vectors

steps.text: Put the concept up; name seven prompts: substitute, combine, adapt, modify, repurpose, eliminate, reverse.
Work one prompt at a time, asking what changes if that verb were mandatory, and write one variant.
Group the variants by prompt, then keep the ones worth developing and record each prompt.

failure: Half-working looks like ordinary ideas with a verb written beside each: the prompts decorate the output.
intervention: Pick one prompt and force it: state exactly what changes.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A seven-prompt creativity checklist used in ideation workshops; no origin given in the source.
